title: Nighttime Stretch Benefits
hook: What if you stretch before bed?

description: A quick look at how nightly stretching can calm your body and boost sleep.

facts.claim: Gentle stretching before bedtime can help relax muscles and lower tension.
Stretching increases blood flow to muscles, promoting circulation.
facts.source: American Council on Exercise – Benefits of Stretching

facts.claim: Light stretching can activate the parasympathetic nervous system, reducing heart rate.
Practicing stretching in the evening may improve sleep quality and reduce time to fall asleep.
facts.source: International Journal of Yoga, 2015 – Effects of yoga on sleep

facts.claim: Consistent nightly stretching can increase flexibility over weeks, enhancing range of motion.
facts.source: National Academy of Sports Medicine – Stretching guidelines

topic: What happens if you stretch before bed each night?
